corrections: Warwick master year 1990 conflicts with company filing and interview 1991. Omit master graduation year. Homeopathy-based strategy claims not endorsed as scientific evidence.
Read Rajiv appointment and Annexure A only. Master year 1991 differs from group biography; 2020 reappointment is historical, not current term.
Historical market rankings and partner relationships not asserted current. Strategy is the executive’s account, not independent proof of every claimed benefit.
Do not copy another retrospective’s claim he was already MD in 2001; product and team contributions not sole personal invention.
2020 launch distinct from earlier unveiling and historical petrol Chetak; no launch date equated with first delivery or national availability.
Fuel efficiency, range and export ambitions are claims/plans, not independently verified outcomes. Not electric or zero-emission.
Read relevant appointment and history sections only. 2030 is scheduled term end, not completed service. Rakesh Sharma joint MD does not replace Rajiv.
Read acquisition key-audit-matter paragraphs only, not full financials. Corporate indirect control, not Rajiv personal purchase, 100% KTM ownership or proven turnaround.
Bajaj Group centenary is not Bajaj Auto’s centenary. Niraj is Auto chairman; Nirav leads new healthcare business, not Rajiv.
Read relevant table entries, not independent verification of all outside appointments. Do not confuse Sanjiv’s finance/Finserv chairmanship with Rajiv.
